```{python}
#| echo: false
import pandas as pd
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "../scripts")
from theme import ESPRIT, evolution_bar, evolution_cumul, mpl_barh, mpl_donut

from itables import init_notebook_mode, show
init_notebook_mode(all_interactive=True, connected=True)

rap = pd.read_csv("../data/rapporteurs.csv")
for c in rap.select_dtypes(include="object").columns:
    rap[c] = rap[c].astype(str).str.strip()
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

n_total = len(rap)
n_etudiants = rap[["nom", "prenom"]].drop_duplicates().shape[0]
n_soutenus = rap["statut"].str.contains("Soutenu|Terminé", na=False).sum()
n_encours = (rap["statut"] == "En cours").sum()

print(f'''
<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(160px,1fr));gap:0.8rem;margin:1rem 0;">
  <div class="kpi"><span class="value">{n_total}</span><span class="label">Rapports évalués</span></div>
  <div class="kpi"><span class="value">{n_etudiants}</span><span class="label">Étudiants</span></div>
  <div class="kpi"><span class="value">{n_soutenus}</span><span class="label">Soutenus</span></div>
  <div class="kpi"><span class="value">{n_encours}</span><span class="label">En cours</span></div>
</div>
''')
```

## Évolution temporelle

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| layout-ncol: 2

evolution_bar(rap, "Rapports évalués par année et niveau",
              [ESPRIT[5], ESPRIT[8], ESPRIT[1]]).show()
evolution_cumul(rap, "Rapports évalués cumulés au fil des années",
                "#6A1B9A", "rgba(106,27,154,0.08)").show()
```

## Répartitions

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| layout-ncol: 2

mpl_barh(rap["formation"].value_counts(), "Rapports évalués par formation", couleur="#6A1B9A")
mpl_donut(rap["niveau"].str.strip().value_counts(), "Répartition par niveau",
          colors=[ESPRIT[3], ESPRIT[4], ESPRIT[1]])
```

## Liste des rapports évalués

```{python}
#| echo: false
table = rap.sort_values("annee", ascending=False)[["annee", "nom", "prenom", "niveau", "formation", "domaine", "perimetre", "statut"]]
table.columns = ["Année", "Nom", "Prénom", "Niveau", "Formation", "Domaine", "Périmètre", "Statut"]
show(table, lengthMenu=[15, 30, 50, 100], classes="display compact")
```
